get.description: Accounts of the project with their current balance, oldest first (cursor pagination, stable order). `owner_id` matches the customer (`cus_`), payee (`pay_`) or provider account (`pva_`) the account belongs to.
One account with its current posted, pending and available balance.

Recomputed from the postings of entries effective at or before `as_of` (RFC 3339 with offset). Only entries that are `posted` count: pending (two-phase) and archived entries are excluded, so holds never move this balance. Entry status history is not stored, so an entry that is posted now counts at its effective time.

get.description: Journal entries, newest first (cursor pagination). `account_id` keeps entries with a posting on that account; `effective_from`/`effective_to` bound `effective_at` (inclusive).
One entry with its postings, metadata, idempotency key, status, reversal links and the correlation/causation ids (the event chain itself is in the events explorer).

Posted debits and credits per currency, account type and account family. Without `as_of` the current materialized balances are summed; with it the totals are recomputed from posted entries effective at or before `as_of`. `balanced` is true when debits equal credits in every currency.
